arms.cached_teacher_kl: Same forward full-vocabulary KL, optimizer/update schedule, row weighting and independent learner initialization; uses the identical fully qualified384-row cached teacher trajectory collection instead of student samples.
arms.cached_teacher_sft: Same384-row cache, exactly frozen response_nll and four micro-backward contributions /4; identical AdamW defaults, clip1, schedule and initialization. No teacher forward during updates. CPU comparison proves bitwise adapter+optimizer equality to frozen SFT loop on a real tiny Qwen model. Full-size equality is measured, not assumed.
arms.onpolicy_kl: At each pre-update learner state, four raw TRAIN prompts receive fresh temperature1 student samples. Full-vocabulary FP64 softmax categorical sampling preserves positive numerical support for every output ID; logits are FP32. Native EOS stops, 16-token cap adds no EOS; no top-k/top-p/repetition processors/special-token suppression. Cached KV sampling; teacher/student losses recomputed on identical complete prompt+sample prefix with causal masking. Teacher||student forward KL sums every vocabulary ID, token-mean per response then row-mean of4. Prefix samples and teacher probabilities detached.

budgets_and_capacity.student_loss_token_exposures: measured separately; onpolicy variable lengths vs cached 7 tokens, same row/update budget does not imply token/compute matching

control.use: Copy and hash original coverage training/schedule/cache/result/panels as descriptive comparator. New SFT final tensor hash and heldout generations compared with this exact completed artifact; mismatch reported without tuning.384teacher targets previously token-identical oracle, so no hard-label novelty claim.

diagnostics.aggregates: prefix_diagnostics.json recomputed from every trajectory per task and fixed checkpoint interval. Cached target grades explicitly not student generated performance. Reports divergent teacher statistics without treating them as correctness.
diagnostics.every_exposure: trajectories.jsonl stores update/microstep/TRAIN ID/hash, prompt and response tokens/raw decode, native grading, actual pre-update clock, full prediction mask, vocabulary size, loss tokens, KL direction by sealed protocol, row loss, student/teacher argmax, sampled-token logp, entropy/EOS probabilities, canonical-prefix agreement and full-support minima.
diagnostics.update_ledger: Actual four row IDs, trajectory hashes, loss tokens, mean per-row loss, clipped gradient norm, actual per-parameter AdamW step minima/maxima.384 clocks and1536exposures required; variable sampled length reported rather than claiming token or compute matching.
diagnostics.weights: Initial/final/checkpoint adapter files plus exact tensor hashes, optimizer files/clocks and changed learner element counts; no dense offset or teacher-initialized learner.

evaluation.before_heldout: Loads a fresh pinned base and ONLY learner adapter. Verifies initial and final hashes, exact24TRAIN native generations and original128 generic-probe score vectors against training snapshots. Fails parity before heldout evaluation. Copied teacher certificate/cache allowed; teacher checkpoint/model files never accessed by evaluator.

generic_retention.scorer: frozen choice_consolidation encode_choices/candidate_logps with original candidate cardinality; raw prompt/no chat, preserved boundary, no EOS, summed full-vocabulary logp divided by answer characters, argmax first tie, candidate batch8 FP32 maxprompt768

evaluation.identity: Checks source execution completed/exit0/timed_outfalse, task/config/embedded supervisor hashes, same source archive and actual bytes. Requires distinct train/eval task IDs and attempt IDs plus standalone CLI. Logs actual child PID/parent PID and supervisor child PID; PID inequality is explicitly not sole proof.
evaluation.native_scoring: Frozen raw prompt and strict complete3digit body plus nativeEOS; same max16/free greedy generation and verify_generated_rows. Per-family correct/format/EOS/cap/error summaries and exact row records.
evaluation.stages: Three separate evaluate jobs; each depends on its completed train job and required runtime gate.

failure_and_claim_boundary: One predeclared fixed-expert hybrid and two matched controls on known Sequence303 mappings, one learner seed and reused previously observed TEST/unused inputs. Native whole answer plus EOS evaluates persistent task adapters after separate-job reload, not broad continual learning, native-base consolidation, autonomous composition, or SDFT/SDPO reproduction. Generic retention is separate original multiple-choice likelihood scoring. Greedy teacher qualification certifies native answers on TRAIN/VAL only, not arbitrary student prefixes. KL and SFT have different objectives and trajectory lengths. No superiority claim before actual completed training and teacher-absent fresh-process evaluation.
